_doc: Configuration for the jaewon-plugin pre-commit gate (in pre-tool-enforcer.mjs). Edit and re-run setup-jaewon to install changes per project.

gate._enabled_doc: When false, the review-evidence + cleanup-scan gate is OFF. Destructive-pattern blocks (rm -rf /, force push, drop table) still apply.
gate._requireBothPasses_doc: When true, both reviewer-structural AND reviewer-deep evidence must be fresh. When false, either pass alone unblocks the commit.
gate._maxAgeMinutes_doc: How long review evidence stays valid after recording.

patterns._doc: Cleanup patterns scanned in staged files. Block on match. Per-language; falls back to 'other' for unrecognized extensions.

complexity._doc: Per-file LOC limits. Function-level limits handled by the reviewer agents.

_bypass_doc: Human bypass: `git commit --no-verify`. Document the reason in the commit body when you do.
